notes.title: 1 Week to Release. Thank you everybody.
notes.notes:
Dear Fiends,

We're excited to announce that "Vorax" is just one week away from releasing in Early Access on July 18th.
 To celebrate this milestone, we released a new teaser trailer that encapsulates the essence of the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMSHbFGU1L4

The journey to this point has been one of relentless effort, passion and dedication. Over the past three years, our team has poured blood, sweat, and tears into finding the perfect balance between survival and horror mechanics. We hope we have succeeded, we will submit to your judgment and we will always try to improve during Early Access.
Furthermore, from an artistic point of view we have always followed our vision and are immensely proud of the monster designs, and we sincerely hope that players enjoy all of these elements as much as we do.

Early Access and Beyond
As we embark on this early access journey, we are committed to continually updating and improving "Vorax." Our goal is to add tons of new content over the next year, with the aim of crafting the best survival horror experience out there. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game, and we look forward to evolving and enhancing the world of "Vorax" together with our community.

We would never have made this release without the support of our community and all Indiegala users that loved our website and our games.
Thanks to everyone who supported us and will support us. Thank you on behalf of the entire Indiegala team.

Stay vigilant and prepare for the horrors that await. Watch the teaser trailer now and get ready to dive into "Vorax" on July 18th.

notes.title: Die Young is out on PS4 & a new PC 1.2.5 Update!
notes.notes:
Die Young is now available on PlayStation 4
https://i.imgur.com/XibGgcm.png
Happy New Year! 2020 has been a long year full of unpleasant surprises, but we wanted to start 2021 strong and with two pleasant surprises.

Firstly, Die Young is now available on the PlayStation Store. We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now. 

Die Young is out now on PS4 in English, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish (screen languages). For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.

Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

Secondly, we have not forgotten about our PC fans. Die Young just got updated on Steam. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update v1.5.0 - Full release incoming!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29067535/33618dd4e36960ed1127ede1f17832e33c789875.png

Bring in some friends and unlock the true potential of Stayin' Alive! In this version:

	Play up to 8 vs 8!
	Four new Suicider characters!
	Hospital map is now fully open!
	Room host can change map and match time directly from Room menu
	Players will always return to Room menu after a match
	Automatic match start is now delayed by some seconds, when a room is full
	Nicer room information box in the Room menu
	Improved AIs behavior (searching items, navigating, etc)
	Savior AIs will drop their passive power-ups after a while, instead of keeping them forever
	Improved item spawning criteria
	Fixed a couple of major bugs when using the Blowgun
	More bug fixing and improvements here and there

Time to go all in! You can now choose to play with up to 8 players per team, included AIs like before.
Hospital map will now open up to all four floors, depending by the number of players in a room (when playing 8 vs 8, maps will always be fully open).

Next, we decided to drop the concept of "Single round", "Multiple rounds" and "Map rotation" for a clearer experience. From now on the host will be able to change map and time in the Room menu, and after every match all players will be sent back to the Room screen.

Full release coming soon!
We are going out of Early Access in a few weeks! We will have just a couple more updates before that day. After that, we will continue supporting the game with fixes and some more extra content. :)

This is all for today's update. Thanks for playing and stay tuned! ;)

notes.title: April development update
notes.notes:
Hello players! We have been a bit silent because the lead programmer was ill for two weeks (me ç_ç), but now we are back on track. :)

Last but not least, we want to increase the number of players from 4 vs 4 to 8 vs 8! Large maps with variable layout like the Hospital and the Museum will benefit from this.

Stay tuned and thanks for playing!

notes.title: February development update
notes.notes:
Hello players!
Just checking in to summarize what we are up to. Before revealing the new map (happening soon!), we are going to update the game with a couple of things some of you asked for.

Player stats and ranking
This new menu page will list game stats (such as total game time, favorite tools, etc.), plus showing a personal medal and ranking based on your level. Brag with your opponents!
Later in the development, experience points will not only affect your ranking; high levels will unlock special items to customize your character. Keep in mind that customization is still a big work in progress!

Control mapping
Exactly what you'd expect: map controls freely both for mouse/keyboard and joypad.

OSX support
Apple computers will no longer be safe from Stayin' Alive.

We plan to roll out this update at the beginning of the next week, but we are trying to squeeze it in this weekend.
Stay tuned!

	Fixed getting stuck in crafting animation
	Fixed disabled audio when playing as Client
	Fixed missing music when joining a started match
	Improved logic when joining a match
	Fixed various syncing bugs

We managed to fix many sync problems by changing the logic of how a player joins a match. Now, when joining a started match, the player will replace any bot that is not in a special condition (like dying, crafting, sedated, ecc). If all the bots are "busy" in that moment, the game will just wait for the first one to free up.
This is an elegant solution that makes things way easier to sync, and it's nicer for players.

EDIT: now that v1.0.0 is out, more players are playing and more bugs are spawning. :D

notes.title: Update v0.7.4
notes.notes:
We just released a very bulky update! Check it out:

	Fixed a lot of critical sync issues!
	Hospital: all four floors are now open!
	Hospital: items thrown in the stairwell will now respawn, if lowest floor is not used
	Fixed lagging doors on Clients
	Bot players now get stuck way less often
	Fixed rendering issues with some suicider body parts
	Chat won't send empty messages anymore
	Added back the dizziness effect when a suicider is sedated
	Text in Room menu is easier to read
	Fixed alignment problems with chat in Room menu
	More small bug fixes and improvements

Almost all of the sync issues are gone and the game should finally be playable nicely now; more fixes will follow during this week of course. Sorry for having kept you waiting!
About the Hospital: it's indeed a very big map and we would like to test it to its full extents. From now on, the more the players, the more floors will be open:

	2-3 players: 1 floor
	4-5 players: 2 floors
	6-7 players: 3 floors
	8 players: 4 floors

The match will always start from the first floor of the Hospital as usual. The map is big enough to support even double that number of players, but this is something we may experiment later... ;)
Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update v0.7.3
notes.notes:
Hello players, we have another small, but important update. In this version:

	Added private rooms! (not available in demo version)
	Fixed syncing issues that made the game unstable at times
	Fixed heavy stuttering on Clients
	Fixed a problem with characters rendering
	More small bug fixes and improvements


Private rooms should be a nice extra for those who want to set up a match with friends only. As we wrote in the previous changelog, this is the first feature that will not be available in the demo version. Demo version and complete version will still remain cross-compatible.

We also reduced the number of selectable servers from 10 to just 4, keeping only servers from main regions. This should help players find each other more easily while still having an acceptable ping. This is not a permanent solution anyways. ;)

Last but not least, we didn't forget about bot issues in the Hospital! They are next in the line of things to fix, now that syncing issues are mostly gone.

It's a wrap for this weekend! Happy gaming!

notes.title: Speak German? + Dev update
notes.notes:
Hello players! 

Beta channel build with German translation
Gamescom has started and IndieGala is now there with Stayin' Alive among the other games. The event is taking place in Germany, so we thought it could make sense to have German language in the game!

Language management code is yet to be perfected, so we only uploaded it to the Beta branch build of the Demo version. Please note that this new build is marked as 0.6.2 thus wont' play against current 0.6.1 version; maybe grab a friend and try the new german build together! Also note that 0.6.2 actually defaults to EU server in order to help players at Gamescom. It will default back to USW when released in the Default channel.

If you want to test it, go to the game Properties in the Steam Client, select the Betas tab and then choose "beta -" from the dropdown list. That's it!

Development update
Some days ago we revealed the new Hospital map and we hope you liked it. We really wanted to add it to this new build in the Beta channel but unfortunately, due to problems with the old codebase, we really couldn't make it in time and chosen to continue making progress instead.
We are sorry to keep you waiting but we are getting there, there's not much left! We promise you a smoother experience and way more content updates when all this work is done. Just hang on a bit more! ç_ç

Thanks for sticking with us! Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update v0.6.0
notes.notes:
Hello players! A new update awaits our brave saviors and suiciders:

	Added basic support for commonly used joypads
	Better handling of connection errors in the menu
	It is no longer possible to kick players from the room during the start countdown
	Fixed a crash when players would disconnected abruptly during a match, both due to being kicked or due to sudden connettivity issues
	Suiciders can no longer grab, craft, and use objects while committing suicide, just as it should be
	Puddle particles are now correctly deleted from the scene after their animation is over
	Added some sound effects to the scene
	More bug fixing


Button mapping (standard X360 joypad)

	Left stick - Move
	Right stick - Look around
	LB - Grab or throw object with left hand
	RB - Grab or throw object with right hand
	LT, A - Sprint
	X - Use object in left hand / Craft objects
	B - Use object in right hand / Conduct wheelchair / Suicide
	Y - Open door
	Back - Show player list
	Start - Open pause menu

We are still working on joypad support and we want to extend it by the final release (for example, menu navigation is still not working with joypad control, and button mapping is not as good as we would have wanted).
As usual, we hope you are enjoying the game; we just love your gameplay videos! Reach us in the community to report bugs and talk about the game in general. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update v0.4.0
notes.notes:
Let's begin with the first update to the Open Alpha of Stayin' Alive! In this version:

    Added an in-game cheatsheet for crafting and item usage
    Added some hints for important events
    Added missing cure objects (Gastric lavage, Rubber glove)
    Razor and toothbrush are now correctly craftable
    Fixed wrong item icons
    Balanced the quantity of items in the map
    Saviors will now find a cure item for each type in their control room
    More minor bug fixing all around

We are aware of some easily noticeable problems that we are going to fix asap, in particular:

    Changing game settings crashes the game
    Electroshock particles may randomly crash the game
    Select Server menu goes back to main menu
    In some cases, menu pages have a wrong behavior

We hope you are enjoying the game! Reach us on the community to report bugs and talk about the game in general. Thanks for playing!
